findings.claim: Measured throughput (498.99 events/sec) misses the stated target of 500 events/sec and only passes because the newly added thresholds block introduces a lower minEventsPerSecond of 490, while acceptance criterion task 11 requires evidence of "responsive 500-event interaction".
findings.evidence: Hunk changes achievedEventsPerSecond to 498.9920360871412 and adds "thresholds": { "targetEventsPerSecond": 500, "minEventsPerSecond": 490, ... } in the same edit; the pass verdict thus rests on a threshold that did not exist in the prior evidence revision.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the 490 eps floor is the contractually accepted bound (cite the ui-spec or task-11 gate definition in the evidence), or re-run until achievedEventsPerSecond >= 500 so the receipt meets the stated target rather than a newly introduced minimum.

findings.claim: Every test's reported spec line number shifted by exactly +8 (84→92, 104→112, 129→137, 183→191, 241→249), proving v3-devtools-react-inspector.spec.ts was edited between evidence runs, but this diff contains no change to that spec file, so the evidence was generated from a spec version that is not part of this change.
findings.evidence: Playwright report hunks show "line": 84→92, 104→112, 129→137, 183→191, 241→249 and source.commit changed from 7ff2fe285dc630b618ae9f7d7b21967e0ef1e29d to febc1835ad63a86319656af004ce037b752bb4e8, with no corresponding spec/production hunk in the diff.
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure the spec edit that produced the +8 line shift is committed in the same or a prior change and that "dirtyTaskFiles": false was evaluated against a tree containing it; otherwise the evidence does not correspond to the committed code under review.

findings.claim: searchLatencyP95Ms regressed ~26% (19.4ms → 24.4ms) between the two evidence revisions with no accompanying code change in this diff, indicating either measurement instability or an unrecorded change affecting search performance.
findings.evidence: Hunk changes "searchLatencyP95Ms": 19.399999998509884 → 24.400000002235174 while the diff touches only evidence artifacts, so nothing in this change explains the latency movement.
findings.suggested_fix: Note the variance in the evidence or gate on a stable environment; if the regression is real, identify the causing commit before archiving task 11.

findings.claim: The acceptance record now carries both gateStartedAt and generatedAt but no field recording which threshold set the pass verdict was evaluated against, so a future schema consumer cannot tell whether the older threshold-less evidence was judged by the same bar.
findings.evidence: The thresholds object was added only to the nested performance receipt; the top-level acceptance envelope gained gateStartedAt/generatedAt but no reference to the gate/threshold version used.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a gateVersion or thresholdSnapshot reference at the envelope level so receipts are self-describing about the criteria they passed.
